claims.text: The source defines GenEval: 6 tasks x 553 templated prompts (COCO-80 objects, 11 Berlin-Kay colours); Mask2Former detector (confidence 0.3, 0.9 for counting) for presence/count/centroid-position plus CLIP ViT-L/14 on masked crops for colour; binary per-image correctness averaged per task.

Reported numbers: human agreement 83% overall (inter-annotator 88%), 91% on unanimous subset vs CLIPScore 80%/87%; IF-XL overall 0.61, SD-v2.1 0.50; position subtasks at most 15%, binding at most 35%.

limitations.text: Closed COCO-80 vocabulary; photo-trained detector fails on holes/overlaps/clipart; ignores aesthetics/realism.

limitations.text: Open-vocabulary generalisation beyond tested models not established.
